en.tajweedCoaching.title: Practise these sounds
en.tajweedCoaching.intro: A short plan built from your own Qur'an practice. It picks tajweed sounds that appear in the ayahs you're working on and uses words from your own recitation as examples.
en.tajweedCoaching.honesty: This plan isn't a judgement of your tajweed: it comes from words the listener asked you to try again, and the app can't check tajweed inside an ayah. Sound drills listen for one sound in one word, and only where that check has been measured to work. A qualified teacher is the best guide.
en.tajweedCoaching.tvReadOnly: Practice needs a microphone, so it's available on your phone, tablet or computer. You can still read the rules and listen to the words here.
en.tajweedCoaching.summaryIntro: From the ayahs you just practised.
en.tajweedCoaching.privacy: Your plan is worked out on this device. Your recitation audio never leaves it.
en.tajweedCoaching.empty.building: Building your plan from your practice…
en.tajweedCoaching.empty.offline: Connect to the internet once so the app can fetch the tajweed markings for your ayahs. After that, it works offline.
en.tajweedCoaching.empty.nothing: The ayahs you practised recently don't include a sound to coach yet. Keep practising and the plan will grow.
en.tajweedCoaching.empty.noPractice: Practise a few ayahs in Qur'an practice and your coaching plan will appear here.
